Xi, Trump, and Putin Summit Makes History but Not Much Else

It was the first-ever meeting of the leaders of the world’s three biggest nuclear powers—one that host Xi Jinping opened by hailing its “pioneering significance.” Exactly what was achieved when Xi met with Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump at Kylin Villa in northwestern Shenzhen on Thursday, however, has onlookers scratching their heads.
